quarterly_data.signal: Alibaba's 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026: Cloud Intelligence Group revenue (before inter-segment elimination) was RMB 158,132 million (US$22,924 million), up 34% from RMB 118,028 million in fiscal 2025 (RMB 106,374 million in fiscal 2024); its adjusted EBITA was RMB 14,265 million, up 35% from RMB 10,556 million. By revenue type, cloud services revenue was RMB 112,077 million versus RMB 84,517 million. Cloud Intelligence Group depreciation and impairment of property and equipment (and land-use-right lease cost) rose to RMB 28,921 million from RMB 15,911 million. Group consolidated revenue was RMB 1,023,670 million, up 3%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 Cloud Intelligence Group revenue RMB 158,132 million (+34%); adjusted EBITA RMB 14,265 million (+35%); cloud services revenue RMB 112,077 million; cloud depreciation RMB 28,921 million

quarterly_data.signal: Alibaba's 20-F: capital expenditures totaled RMB 126,063 million (US$18,275 million) in fiscal year 2026 (ended March 31, 2026), versus RMB 85,972 million in fiscal 2025 and RMB 32,087 million in fiscal 2024, incurred primarily for the acquisition of computer equipment and construction of data centers relating to its Cloud business and the operation of its mobile platforms and websites, plus logistics infrastructure and corporate campuses. Capital commitments contracted but not provided for, which primarily relate to purchases of property and equipment including the cloud infrastructure and construction of corporate campuses, amounted to RMB 54,136 million (US$7,848 million) as of March 31, 2026, versus RMB 45,321 million a year earlier; RMB 53,484 million of it falls due no later than one year.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex RMB 126,063 million (US$18,275 million) vs RMB 85,972 million (FY2025) and RMB 32,087 million (FY2024); capital commitments RMB 54,136 million at March 31, 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Ant Group (related party): Alibaba's 20-F reports cloud services revenue from Ant Group and its affiliates of RMB 19,134 million (US$2,774 million) in fiscal year 2026, up from RMB 11,113 million in fiscal 2025 and RMB 8,814 million in fiscal 2024; Alibaba provides Ant Group and its affiliates with cloud computing services, marketplace software technology services and other services.
